direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone; all targets at least 36px, rail targets equal width, non-wrapping, with aria-current and arrow-key movement
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, cross marker and plain OFFLINE text; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions tied to real state; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory SVG to at least 70% of main and add depth, state glow and living material flow along the held route; keep callouts, stations and jobs in independent reserved zones.
Refit the scene header so the second logo placement in the opening story reads as a deliberate branded title block at native aspect, not a small repeated thumbnail.
Raise side-zone body copy to 16px/24 and give each Source detail control a visible 2px emerald focus ring.
Separate connection readiness checks for provider identity from the investigation evidence task with distinct headings, status lines and controls in the side zone.
Make the hatched CELL-MILL-2 state carry a clear cross marker and plain OFFLINE label at 16px, with no route drawn through it, and animate only the two feasible emerald paths.
Compress the Verified findings panel inside its reserved zone so the 0 / 0 / 2 metrics and one-line outcome fit without crowding the primary action.
Increase selected-path affordance: when a Select this path option is chosen, glow its matching SVG route and show the one-click Approve, then the Authorize this decision wall.
Enlarge tradeoff metrics to 26px tabular figures aligned in fixed columns so 83h, 35h and 17.5h scan instantly at 1366x768.
Add bidirectional highlighting between each comparison row and its bottom option tile in the scene.
Keep the pending proposal clearly untracked until approval: strengthen the dashed silver treatment on t2 and t3 while the single Approve primary retains the emerald glow.
Give task cards depth and a subtle state glow on the ready t1 card, with flow paused under reduced motion.
Raise small due and dependency labels to at least 12px and body text to 16px within the reserved station and job zones.
Make the preview cinematic: one 240ms emerald route trace withdraws from CELL-MILL-2 as its cross-hatching, cross marker and OFFLINE text settle, then hold static.
Enlarge the 24h to 0h preview metric and keep it inside the scene callout zone so it never overlaps station cards.
Clarify the side-zone machine selector label at 16px and add a focus ring to the dropdown control.
Fill the empty Verified findings reserved zone with a concise pre-run state at 16px so the panel does not read as unfinished space.
Keep provider identity readiness and the evidence investigation as separate side-zone blocks with independent status and controls.
Add living flow only on feasible routes through CELL-MILL-1 and leave the offline cell pattern-only, honouring reduced motion.
Emphasise the constrained Split path with silver cross-hatching plus plain text in both the comparison row and the scene tile, matched by bidirectional highlighting.
Glow the two feasible emerald routes in the SVG when their comparison rows are focused or hovered.
Refit the invalidated-acceptance status in the action bar to one centred 16px sentence beside the single primary.
Visually separate the 3 blocked prior tasks from the 3 proposed replacements with distinct silver hatching for blocked and dashed untracked treatment for proposed, since both legitimately coexist.
Show CELL-MILL-2 as OFFLINE with cross marker in the station zone and direct all flow through CELL-MILL-1 with state glow.
Condense the right board so proposed and blocked groups both fit their reserved zones at 1366x768 without overlap.
Add cinematic depth to the three proof stages: emerald glow on Verify ledger, silver locked treatment on stages 2 and 3, and a single route trace linking them on verification.
Raise the dense right-zone checklist and passphrase guidance to 16px/24 and enlarge its input target to at least 36px.
Keep exactly one emerald primary, Verify ledger, in the action bar and mute duplicate inline stage buttons to silver.
Fix contradictory labelling: departments showing 5 offline cannot also read RUNNING 5 machines in emerald; align counts, legend and machine states to real state only.
Scale down the oversized Assembly OFFLINE cubes and refit all 45 machines so the full-shop cascade fills the viewport evenly with readable flow lines between departments.
Give running machines emerald state glow and moving material flow, offline machines silver cross-hatching with cross markers, and honour reduced motion throughout.
Preserve the strong opening order and the required logo placements; enlarge the hero logo title lockup slightly and lift the Live demo link to a clear emerald primary at 16px.
Refit the embedded full-shop screenshot so its department labels and OFFLINE states stay legible at page width, with a caption tied to the cascade story.
Tighten the long page rhythm with larger section spacing contrast and 18/24 subheads so judges reach What you'll see and the human-approval story within the first scan.
